data.name: Aryisha
data.gender_notes: Aryisha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'arya' which means moon. The suffix '-isha' denotes a radiant or shining one. In Islamic tradition, the moon represents peace, calmness, and tranquility. The name Aryisha carries the meaning “Moonlight, radiant one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aryisha usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight, radiant one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the peaceful and calming influence of the moon in Islamic spirituality.
data.etymology: Aryisha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moonlight, radiant one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aryisha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
